QuestInfo.name: Winding Back the Clock
QuestInfo.0: The Goddess's powers remained behind, powering Mirror World, and she was reborn. She found herself in Zero's Temple as a very small child, as #p2400005# and #p2400006#, the incomplete Transcendent of Time, left for Maple World.
